page.overview:
Who is Gretchen Duvall?

Jessica Duvall † (mother) Becky Duvall † (aunt) Jack Duvall † (cousin)

Gretchen Duvall, was a minor yet crucial character in Invincible, debuting in Season 3. She was the late niece of Scott Duvall, who was killed in the Destruction of Chicago.

The demise of Gretchen and her mother is the primary reason why her uncle targeted Invincible, as he blamed him as much as he blamed his father, Omni-Man, for his role in their deaths.

Gretchen was a young girl with a brown complexion, short brown hair, and brown eyes.
